title: Node file watching inside Docker misses changes on macOS bind mounts
symptoms: Hot reload does not detect edits
Works on native Node outside Docker
cause: Filesystem event propagation across Docker Desktop bind mounts can be unreliable; watchers relying on inotify-style events may not see host writes.
solution: Use polling-based watch (e.g. CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING/WATCHPACK_POLLING) or develop Node on host and only containerize runtime. Keep bind mounts narrow.
workaround: Manual restart on change for small tasks.
